title: A complete 3D cross-section of all the machinery inside one human cell
title_candidates: What scientists found when they mapped the inside of a human cell in 3D
The most detailed 3D map ever made of everything inside a human cell
A complete 3D cross-section of all the machinery inside one human cell
This is what your cells actually look like from the inside
How scientists built a full 3D model of what is inside a human cell
caption:
Researchers built the most detailed 3D model of a human cell ever made, mapping every tiny structure that keeps you alive.

This is called a Cellular Landscape Cross-Section of a eukaryotic cell. Scientists used advanced imaging to reconstruct the full interior in three dimensions, capturing organelles, proteins, and molecular machinery all in the same frame at this level of detail for the first time.

Seeing the complete picture changes how scientists approach disease. The goal is to understand exactly how cells break down, so medicine can get there first.
